verdict.rationale: The product is published as a public GitHub repository whose source is evidently readable and buildable: editable prompts in prompts/, hardware/hid_bridge/nimble_cfg.h, flash.sh, hardware/tools/board_test.py, and a self-signed app build. Nothing in the evidence names a license, so the 'open license' half of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: any stated open-source license (e.g. MIT/Apache/GPL), a LICENSE file reference, independent confirmation of licensing terms.
